mapper.select: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'AVAILABLE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS available, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'RENTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rented, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'BROKEN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS broken FROM EQUIPMENT GROUP BY category ORDER BY category

SELECT r.rental_id, r.equipment_id, e.equipment_name, r.rental_date, r.return_date, r.request_status FROM RENTAL r JOIN EQUIPMENT e ON r.equipment_id = e.equipment_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.actual_return_date IS NULL ORDER BY r.rental_id DESC

SELECT equipment_name, category, COUNT(*) AS available_count FROM EQUIPMENT WHERE category = #{category} AND status = 'AVAILABLE' GROUP BY equipment_name, category HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY equipment_name ASC
